Title: JuqBawx - Music Visualizer
Desc: 36 system-audio reactive visualizers, from Winamp-era scopes to MilkDrop feedback tunnels to WebGL fragment shaders with automatic Canvas fallbacks. Album-art palettes, pointer interaction, ambient modes, themed packs, per-visualizer profiles, and a full-screen Now Playing readout built from the Windows media session.
Author: raystanza
